name: ress-current-timing
supersedes: v1 RTP/sequence/SSRC rebasing and near-zero NTP normalization are SUPERSEDED; v2 retains raw generic counters

normalizations.arrival: capture origin subtracted; integer microsecond precision expressed as ns
normalizations.rtp_timestamp: RAW uint32 counters unchanged, including matching raw SR RTPTime and wrap/offset conditions
normalizations.sender_ntp: one COMMON audio/video WHOLE-SECOND shift into positive2000 NTP epoch; original uint32 fractional bits unchanged
normalizations.absolute_source_vs_host_epoch_trust: UNQUALIFIED; synthetic positive epoch is not observed source/host wallclock agreement
normalizations.ssrc: RAW: video0 and shared audio10 preserved
normalizations.sequence: RAW uint16 counters unchanged; no first-packet rebasing
normalizations.identities: synthetic IDs only; equivalent audio transports share IDs

content_policy: No source addresses/ports/URLs/credentials, original audio/video/SPS/NAL bytes, or actual media-payload hashes are included.
replay_limit: Header/timing replay only. Synthetic payloads are opaque and not codec-valid H264. NAL metadata must drive an explicit test adapter; do not claim real codec/bootstrap replay.
